name: application-barcode-scan-row
title: Barcode Scan Row
description: Dense POS scan-log rows with SKU, item name, quantity, computed line total, and a void action — distinct from cart-line-item, which is a rich e-commerce card with a product image and quantity stepper rather than a compact scan-log table row.
useWhen: Displaying a running log of items scanned at a point-of-sale terminal.
You need a dense, fast-scanning list rather than a rich product card per item.
Cashiers need a quick void action per scanned line.
avoidWhen: You're building a customer-facing e-commerce cart with product images — use cart-line-item instead.
You need an itemized printable receipt layout — use receipt-preview instead.
Items don't have a SKU/barcode identifier — a simpler list is sufficient.
responsiveBehavior: Rows are full-width within their container; the item name truncates first to preserve the SKU, quantity, line total, and void action.
accessibility: The void button's aria-label names the specific item being voided, not just 'Void'.
SKU codes render as monospace <code> to visually distinguish them from the item name.
Line totals are computed from unitPrice × quantity, never hand-typed independently.

variants.title: Barcode scan row
variants.description: Three scanned items with real computed line totals (unit price × quantity) and per-row void actions, on a light surface.
accessibility: Each void button's aria-label is item-specific, aiding screen reader users scanning a long list.

variants.title: Barcode scan row (Dark)
variants.description: The same three-item scan log, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Text and void-action colors meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
